## What's your question?

Ask anything about setup, presets, skills, or how the kit works.

## Want to contribute?

If you're asking how to get involved: the fastest path today is a preset — see
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) for the guide — or a skill, using
`templates/skill-template/` for the 9-section format the wizard installs. Not
sure where to start? Describe what you're trying to add or fix below and a
maintainer will point you in the right direction.

## Additional context

Anything else that helps — what you've already tried, links, or examples.
